title: ai-rulez roles manifest
description: roles.json, written next to config.toml by `ai-rulez generate` when [role_manifest] enabled = true, and printed by `ai-rulez roles list --format json`. A stable, deterministic (no timestamps) interface for an identity tool or a UI: every role with the items it resolves to.

tokenizer.description: Counter used for every tokens figure (an approximation).

match.description: Hints an external tool maps to this role (for example identity-provider groups). ai-rulez never interprets them. Not inherited through extends.

domains.description: Domains the role selects, inherited ones included.

skill_modes.description: Skill id to the Claude Code skillOverrides state the role sets.

delivery.description: Skill id or glob (domain/id for one domain) to the delivery the role sets, inherited entries merged in.

served_skills.description: Skills the role gets through the skills server only (not listed in context).

served_tokens.description: Share of tokens held by those skills.

path.description: Source path relative to the configuration directory.

mode.description: skill_mode the role sets for this skill.

delivery.description: How a skill reaches the agent: written to the skill trees (static), fetched over MCP on demand and never listed (served), or both.

bytes.description: Source size on disk; a skill counts its resources.
